en:
The DeLorean was and still is best known for being a time
machine in the movie "Back to the Future."

The car was built by DMC, founded by John Z. DeLorean,
a former vice president at General Motors.

This car was its first and only production model. Called the
DMC-12, DeLorean oversaw the entire creation process.

Financial woes forced DMC to close its doors after the car came
out. but it's still around today under different ownership.

The car you see here is the "Series 2," a remake proposed
by the new DMC.

Its key feature is an improved 200ps engine.

三方公司出手相助，这个品牌才得以存续。

制版，

en:
This original Gran Turismo Gr.4 race car
is based on the S15 Silvia Spec-R.

Its most distinctive feature is its strikingly wide body.

About 170mm wider than the normal car's body, it
comes with wide race tires.

As the "Touring Car" name implies, this model was designed
for the race track.

Oh, and because the Silvia is also a popular drift car,
the basic handling balance has been left intact.

And, the handbrake is also still there,
in case you wanted to break the rear tires loose.

Whether you're looking for grip on the track or hoping to
drift around corners, this car is always a joy to drive!

比一般车宽了约170mm，所以可以容纳下宽大的赛车轮胎。

事实上，为了兼顾漂移性能，这辆车甚至完整地保留了
手刹的配置。

不论是想要足够的赛道抓地力，还是追求漂移过弯时的
爽快感，这辆车一定都能够让您称心如意！

en:
The DeLorean DMC-12 became world famous after
it appeared in the movie "Back to the Future."

No one expected this car to be converted into a time machine,
but its futuristic appearance made it the perfect choice.

The car employed an RR layout, similar to that of the Porsche 911,
but power from the V-6 was rated at only 130ps.

Later versions would get an improved engine
that delivered up to 200ps.

While the production run of this unique sports car was short,
it remains one of the most recognized American cars ever.

采用与保时捷911相同的后置后驱布局，
V6引擎在发售时原本只有130ps。

之后的版本采用了经过改良的引擎，
将动力提升至200ps。

掌握这样强大的动力，
为你带来乐趣无穷的驾驶体验！

en:
Lancia of Italy is well known for its feats in
rally racing...

And the Lancia Delta S4 stands out as one of their
best machines.

The Delta S4 competed in the Group B category,
the top class of rally racing of the 1980s.

At the time, the Group B category only required 200 street
cars to be produced to meet homologation requirements.

Mainstream Group B machines combined midship turbo
engines with four-wheel drive.

However the Delta S4 took things a step further...

Adding a supercharger to its turbocharged engine.

Despite its remarkable debut win at the '86 World Rally
Championships...

The ultra-fast Delta S4 was involved in a fatal accident
on the Tour de Corse.

This marked the end of the Group B category.

Considering everything, including its tragic history,
the Delta S4 is a legend among Group B rally cars.�
